A delicious South American condiment that everyone should have in their repertoire.

Many variations of it that include coriander/chilli/basil, but the below is a good start.

  • 1 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, no stems, curly I think is fine too
  • 2 tablespoons fresh oregano leaves (or 2 teaspoons dried)
  • 3-4 garlic cloves
  • 1/2 cup olive oil
  • 2 tablespoons red or white wine vinegar, or maybe a bit less than 2T of lemon juice, to taste
  • 1 teaspoon sea salt
  • 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
  • 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes

Delicious on pretty much everything, except sweet things.
